g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS02 Construction of One Element (procedural or imported) - shared with VIS03
One element -> exactly ONE root Group (BR 2). The representation comes from element.model,
never from element.type (BR 4). Imported models are taken from LoadedAssets by asset id: the URL was
resolved by the back end and the file preloaded by VIS01, so this path never reads a URL (AC 3).
Example: { id: "fridge-1", type: "REFRIGERATOR", model: { source: "ASSET", assetId: "AST-MDL-FRIDGE-01" },
[A1) shape not BOX / CYLINDER / SPHERE / DOME, or a size component not finite and > 0]
